description: A C source file implementing a test function for uploading a file over FTP with file renaming using libcurl. It contains code for initializing libcurl, opening and reading a local file, setting up FTP commands, and performing the upload. The function 'test' is the main entry point, handling resource cleanup and error reporting.

methods.name: CURLcode test(char * URL)
methods.description: Performs an FTP upload with a rename operation after a successful upload, using libcurl. It manages resource allocation and cleanup, configures libcurl options, and handles errors throughout the process.
